title: A-level and BTEC results day arrives for Rochdale students
excerpt: Students across Rochdale are receiving A-level and other Level 3 qualification results today, with university applicants able to check decisions through UCAS and explore Clearing where needed.
body:
Students across Rochdale are receiving A-level and other Level 3 qualification results today as thousands of young people across England find out what comes next after sixth form and college.

Thursday 13 August is the official 2026 results day for A levels, AS levels and T Levels. Ofqual says students taking Level 3 vocational and technical qualifications used for progression to higher education will also receive their results on or before today. This includes many students studying qualifications such as BTECs.

For those who have applied to university, UCAS began updating applicant records from 8am. Students can use the UCAS Hub to see whether their firm or insurance choice has been confirmed. From 1pm, eligible applicants can add a Clearing choice if they need to look for another university or course.

A set of results does not leave students with only one route. Anyone whose grades differ from what they expected can speak to their school or college about the options available, contact universities directly where appropriate, consider Clearing, or look at apprenticeships, further study and employment.

Results day is a major milestone, but it is also the beginning of the next decision rather than the end of the road. Rochdale Daily wishes students across the borough well as they collect their results and make plans for the months ahead.
